name: fight15-s17
title: Ready and Cancel Ready, a setup change, the setup stopping a countdown and the last Ready starting at once

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
combo_select ComboHostActivity Skirmish Defense
wait_combo ComboHostScene Grasslands
combo_select ComboHostScene Grasslands
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 2
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageConnection
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 500
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_ms 1200
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Waiting for Joiner to press Ready
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Everyone is ready - press Start Match
video_mark ready-host
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Waiting for Joiner to press Ready
video_mark ready-taken-back-host
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/saw-cancel.json
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Everyone is ready - press Start Match
activate ButtonLobbyEditSetup
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageRules
wait_ms 400
slider_set SliderHostRulesGold 3000
activate ButtonHostOptApply
wait_ms 900
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_substate Lobby 30
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Waiting for Joiner to press Ready
video_mark setup-changed-host
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/changed.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/saw-changed.json 60
activate ButtonMultiplayerStart
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Starting in
assert_label ButtonMultiplayerStart Cancel Start
activate ButtonLobbyEditSetup
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
assert_label LabelHostOptStatus The start countdown stopped while you change the setup.
video_mark countdown-stopped-host
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/saw-setup-open.json 60
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_substate Lobby 30
wait_ms 1200
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Waiting for Joiner to press Ready
assert_label ButtonMultiplayerStart Start Match
video_mark countdown-cancelled-host
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/countdown-stopped.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/saw-stopped.json 60
activate ButtonMultiplayerStart
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Starting in
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/countdown-running.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 2 90
wait_substate Lobby 90
wait_ms 1200
assert_label ButtonMultiplayerReady Ready
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_label ButtonMultiplayerReady Cancel Ready
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus You're ready
video_mark ready-joiner
wait_ms 1500
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_label ButtonMultiplayerReady Ready
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Press Ready when you're ready to play
video_mark ready-taken-back-joiner
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/saw-cancel.json 60
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_label ButtonMultiplayerReady Cancel Ready
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus The host changed the setup
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus check it and press Ready again
assert_label ButtonMultiplayerReady Ready
video_mark setup-changed-joiner
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/changed.json 60
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/saw-changed.json
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus The host is changing the setup
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus the start waits for it
video_mark setup-open-joiner
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/saw-setup-open.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/countdown-stopped.json 60
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus press Ready
assert_label_absent LabelMultiplayerStatus starting the match in
video_mark countdown-cancelled-joiner
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/saw-stopped.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/countdown-running.json 60
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus The host is starting the match in
video_mark last-ready-joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/last-ready.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
